name: Popei's Clam Bar

evidence.note: Official site mentions live music, a lively bar and an outdoor patio.
Shows the Coram location books 90s party cover bands at 9 pm.
80s new-wave band listing at the Coram location in September 2026.

dancing.notes: Party cover bands play here on weekend nights, but we found no clear reports of a dance area or of people dancing. Call ahead if dancing matters to you.

description: A casual seafood, steak and burger restaurant on Middle Country Road in Coram with a busy bar, an outdoor tiki patio and live bands on weekends.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Popei's has other locations (for example Deer Park, popeis.com); Ira specified Coram. The Daplorabulls gig was not confirmed on the venue's calendar. The Facebook link comes from a Bing listing tied to the Coram address.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Confirmed the Coram location (popeisclambaronline.com); the other Popei's (e.g. popeis.com in Deer Park) is a different restaurant. The Daplorabulls Oct 3 gig noted as unconfirmed earlier IS on the venue's calendar (Sat Oct 3, 9 PM). Facebook URL normalized from the site's link (facebook.com/pages/Popeis-Clam-Bar/740007936025253) to the page ID form; it is the same page as the current value. The site sits behind a Cloudflare bot check, so it was read with a regular browser. Photos are still frames from the venue's own promo video on its home page (Cloudflare Stream thumbnails, 1280x720). Current description kept (the tiki bar is backed by Google's summary; bands play Fri-Sat nights). No dance floor is described.
hours: Mon-Thu 11 AM-11 PM; Fri-Sat 11 AM-12 AM; Sun 12 PM-10 PM
